#!/bin/bash


DIR="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source $DIR/lib.sh

VERSION=$1

# build npm
ROOT="$(realpath "$DIR/..")"

if [ -d "dist" ]; then
  rm dist -rf
fi
mkdir -p dist


if [ -n "$VERSION" ]; then
  echo "Build production packages"
  py_packages_dist $ROOT
else
  echo "Build development packages"
  py_packages_dist_dev $ROOT
fi

ARG DEPENDENCY_PROXY
FROM ${DEPENDENCY_PROXY:-}library/python:3.12-bookworm

ENV PYTHON_VERSION=3

# Accept proxy argument
ARG HTTP_PROXY
ENV HTTP_PROXY=${HTTP_PROXY}

# Optional: also set HTTPS_PROXY if needed
ARG HTTPS_PROXY
ENV HTTPS_PROXY=${HTTPS_PROXY}

RUN if [ -n "$HTTP_PROXY" ]; then \
        echo "Acquire::http::Proxy \"$HTTP_PROXY\";" > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/01proxy; \
    fi && \
    if [ -n "$HTTPS_PROXY" ]; then \
        echo "Acquire::https::Proxy \"$HTTPS_PROXY\";" >> /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/01proxy; \
    fi &&\
    export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive &&\
    apt-get -yy update &&\
    apt-get -yy install --no-install-recommends \
    git \
    ffmpeg \
    portaudio19-dev \
    curl \
    gpg \
    gcc \
    libpq-dev \
    python${PYTHON_VERSION} \
    python${PYTHON_VERSION}-venv \
    python${PYTHON_VERSION}-dev \
    python-is-python3 \
    && \
    pip --no-cache-dir install --break-system-packages uv &&\
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
